findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: The endpoint returns both active and inactive listings (is_live: false records are included). Found 449 inactive listings.
findings.how_found: Paged all listings and inspected is_live boolean property across records.
findings.impact: Clients showing raw responses without checking is_live will display expired/inactive listings to end users.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listing/{listing_id} returns a single listing object.
findings.actual: Endpoint GET /v1/listing/{id} returns 404 Not Found. The actual working endpoint is plural: GET /v1/listings/{id}.
findings.how_found: Probed both singular /v1/listing/{id} and plural /v1/listings/{id} with valid listing IDs.
findings.impact: Clients following documentation get 404 errors on listing detail pages.

findings.documented: Timestamps: ISO 8601, UTC, 'Z' suffix, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: The health endpoint returns a timestamp with explicit +05:30 Indian Standard Time offset rather than UTC 'Z'.
findings.how_found: Called GET /health and inspected the clock string representation.
findings.impact: Parsers assuming strict UTC 'Z' fail or misinterpret timezone offsets.

findings.documented: total_listings is recomputed whenever a listing is added or withdrawn, so it always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: total_listings on project records does not agree with the actual count of listings referencing that project_id in 264 projects.
findings.how_found: Aggregated listing counts by project_id and compared against project.total_listings.
findings.impact: Users see incorrect unit availability counts on project cards.

findings.documented: Each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property with verified specs.
findings.actual: Records exist describing physically impossible properties (e.g. floor exceeding total_floors, carpet area exceeding super built up area).
findings.how_found: Audited physical constraints across all retrieved listing records.
findings.impact: Displays corrupted physical specs in property details unless client filters/corrects them.

findings.documented: The endpoint returns genuine active sale listings in your city.
findings.actual: Fake listings exist with severe pricing anomalies or bait patterns designed to harvest enquiries rather than represent genuine properties.
findings.how_found: Analyzed price-per-square-foot distributions and price anomalies against market medians.
findings.impact: Distorts market analytics and misleads prospective buyers with phantom low-price listings.

findings.documented: Tokens are valid for 24 hours (expires_in: 86400). There is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Access tokens expire in 900 seconds (15 minutes), returning expires_in: 900 and a refresh_token.
findings.how_found: Inspected POST /auth/login response payload properties expires_in and refresh_token.
findings.impact: Clients assuming 24-hour token validity experience unexpected 401 Unauthorized errors after 15 minutes.

findings.actual: POST /auth/refresh exists and accepts {"refresh_token": "..."} to issue a new access token.
findings.how_found: Identified refresh_url in login response and verified POST /auth/refresh endpoint.
findings.impact: Essential for client applications to keep sessions alive beyond 15 minutes without prompting for password.

findings.documented: GET /v1/listings/{listing_id}/similar returns up to ten comparable listings.
findings.how_found: Probed GET /v1/listings/{id}/similar with valid listing IDs.
findings.impact: Property detail pages fail to load comparable recommendations from server.

findings.how_found: Probed GET /v1/analytics/summary with valid API key and authentication headers.
findings.impact: Analytics and insights dashboards fail to load if not calculating metrics client-side.

findings.documented: GET /v1/favourites and POST /v1/favourites manage user saved properties.
findings.actual: Both GET and POST /v1/favourites return 404 Not Found. The active backend endpoint is /v1/saved.
findings.how_found: Probed /v1/favourites and verified 404 status against live server.
findings.impact: Clients following documentation fail to load or persist saved properties.

findings.documented: Every collection endpoint takes `page` and `limit`. `page` is 1-indexed.
findings.actual: The API ignores `page` completely and always returns the first page of results unless `offset` is used.
findings.how_found: Noticed identical listing records on every page when fetching using page=N. Switched to offset=M and retrieved distinct records.
findings.impact: Clients fail to paginate past the first page and retrieve duplicate records indefinitely.

findings.actual: The actual maximum limit is 50. Requesting limit=100 returns only 50 records.
findings.how_found: Requested limit=100 and observed 50 records returned.
findings.impact: Clients expecting 100-200 records per page will under-fetch data or have broken offset calculations.
